name: M3_CRS610MI_ChgBasicData
description: Update basic customer master data for an existing customer. The operation changes only the basic-data fields that you explicitly send; any field you omit is left unchanged and is not overwritten with a blank value. Typical data includes name, address lines, phone and fax numbers, email address, customer type and status, search key, EAN location code, user-defined fields, and geographic information. Most of these fields correspond to what is maintained on panel E in the customer master.

inputParameters.description: Customer number identifying the customer whose basic data is updated.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number for which the customer's basic data is updated.
